info.title: tdcv2 — The Data Constructor
info.description: Command line for TDC — the deterministic test-data generator. Turns a .tdc config into data: generate, check, format, init, and pack. Same seed, same bytes as the TypeScript, Python, Java and Rust implementations. The library itself is the Tdcv2 package.

commands.name: check
commands.description: Validate a config without generating anything

commands.name: format
commands.description: Pretty-print a config (-w writes it in place)

commands.name: init
commands.description: Set up a config (asks where; --yes for defaults)

options.name: --registry
options.description: Use another registry (default: the public one)

options.name: --now
options.description:
Pin the clock date generators read as "now" —
YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss, always UTC.
Without it the run reads the real clock, so a config
using today / now / b_day cannot be reproduced later

options.name: --data-path
options.description: Add a data folder for @data/... sources (repeatable)

options.name: --jobs
options.description:
Worker threads for a large streaming run. Needs -o:
stdout is written by one thread. By default TDC uses
one per core bar one. The count never changes the
output, but it does change the cost: each thread
keeps its own buffers, so memory grows with it. Use
--jobs 1 when memory matters more than time.

options.name: --mode
options.description:
Advanced. disk (default): bounded memory, scales to
any size — TDC picks the streaming or exact engine
automatically from the config. memory: the small,
in-RAM engine (an escape hatch; does not scale)

options.name: --progress
options.description:
Write <output>.progress — a small JSON status file
refreshed about once a second (phase, rows done,
percent). Needs -o. Poll it, or watch its mtime as
a heartbeat: not updated for minutes = not running

options.name: --version
options.description:
Show version and exit
Data paths also come from tdcv2.config.json (nearest one up from the current
directory) and the global config — { "dataPaths": [...], "locale": ".." }.
Order of priority: --data-path > project config > global config > bundled packs.
See https://github.com/NickLiapin/tdcv2 for the DSL reference.
